changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md`

- names `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Both marketplace chunks were held by CHUNK CO-TENANCY, not by any import of the page: rolldown had parked `components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` (statically imported by the eager `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) in the first, and `console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` (bare-imported by the package barrel for its SDUI registration) in the second. An `app-shell-eager-leaves` group in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` isolates those co-tenants so the three declared-lazy pages chunk by their own dynamic-only reachability. The console eager closure moves 3180.2 KB → 3171.5 KB gzipped (−8,888 bytes, 48 → 45 eager chunks) with the three per-chunk ceilings unmoved.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `17b323e5c` (merge-base with origin/main): 6 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1580 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2168 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36321571316)

| **Eager closure** (gzip, 329 chunks) | **3067.7 KB** | 3104.5 KB |
| Main entry chunk (gzip) | 148.3 KB | 350 KB |

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

### ① Derived judgments

**H1, verified from objectstack `origin/main` `805af4f290`, by symbol.**
- Write: `protocol.ts` `saveMetaItem` ends in `repo.put(ref, request.item, { …, state: mode === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'active' })`; `sys-metadata-repository.ts` `SysMetadataRepository.put` stores `metadata: JSON.stringify(body)` with `body = spec ?? {}`, and reads the existing row only for the optimistic-lock hash, the identical-hash `skipped` short-circuit and (draft saves) `package_id` inheritance — never composes it into the body. The pre-put passes strip server-owned keys (`stripReadDecorations`, `stripDerivedProvenance`, `stripServedObjectColumns`), add identity or a declared default (`normalizeViewMetadata`, `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault`), rewrite spellings (flow canonicalisation, `graftNormalizedOperators`, `graftFoldedFormSections`) or carry redacted credential values forward from the stored draft-then-active row (`carryForwardRedactedCredentials`, redactor types only). None merges the prior draft or the active row into the body. "Stored raw" holds for authored content; the PR body's "only ADDS, never subtracts" is loose about the three strips (server-owned keys only).
- Read: `getMetaItem` with `state: 'draft'` reads the `state: 'draft'` row → `convertStoredItem` → `governServedObject` → `decorateMetadataItem`, else throws `NO_DRAFT` 404 ("Draft reads stop here"). On this path `decorateMetadataItem` adds `_diagnostics` only; `_draft: true` is set on the `previewDrafts` arm — the body's "(`_diagnostics`, `_draft`)" is loose, harmless.
- `getMetaItemLayered`: `effective = governServedObject(overlay !== null ? foldObjectExtendersFromRegistry(overlay) : code)`, `overlay` the `state: 'active'` row only. `promoteDraft`: `this.put(ref, draft.body, { state: 'active', opType: 'publish', packageId: draftPackageId })`, then `dropPromotedDraftRow`.
- Doors: `rest-server.ts` maps `?mode=draft` to `{ mode: 'draft' }` on `PUT /meta/:type/:name`; the only PATCH routes are on `/data/:object/:id`. The runtime dispatcher (`runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`) builds its `saveMetaItem` request with no `mode` — never a draft. `client/src/index.ts` `saveItem` forwards the caller's body and `mode`.
- Writers, enumerated independently (`git grep` both trees for `mode: 'draft'`, `mode=draft`, `state: 'draft'`, `saveDraft`, `putDraft`, `.save(`, `.saveItem(`, `saveMetaItem(`): objectui — `ResourceEditPage.doSave` (`itemToSave`), `StudioDesignSurface` ten call sites (skeletons, `draft`, `{ ...appDraft, navigation }`, `objDraft`, `{ ...objDraft, fields }`, `{ ...draft, status }`), `ObjectHooksPanel` two, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.doSave` (`next`), `PermissionMatrixEditor` (`mergePermissionSlice(fresh.effective ?? payload, …)`, draft only with `packageId`), `persistRuntimeMetadata` / `createRuntimeMetadata` (whole report from `ReportView.saveSchema`; `buildViewConfigSaveBody` emits a complete `viewEnvelope`), `ObjectStackAdapter.updateView` (`mergeViewPatch(draft, partial)`, whole). objectstack — REST `PUT ?mode=draft`, `migrateStoredMetadata --apply` (`mode: state === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'publish'`, converted whole row). Every other `saveMetaItem` / `saveItem` caller (`permission-set-projection.ts` four, `packages.ts` app `_unpublished` flip, `duplicatePackage` `mode: 'publish'`, `cli/commands/meta/register.ts`, console `meta.saveItem` sites, plugin-designer, `EmbeddedItemEditor`, `DatasourceResourcePage`) writes publish mode. No partial draft writer exists; no writer the dev missed. Premise: ALWAYS FULL. A stock boot is NOT MEASURED here either (objectstack `node_modules` empty) — source-cited.

**H2.** `type` is inside every draft these editors write; page `type` is filled on the read seam too (`convertStoredItem` → `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault`). `toDraft` / `fromDraft` are declared on the `registry.ts` interface and defined by no registered config (`builtinComponents.tsx` states none) — the new post-publish call is inert today. Fallback: all three `ResourceEditPage` sites read `client.getDraft(…).catch(() => null)`; `MetadataClient.readItemResponse` returns `null` on 404 and throws otherwise, so the `.catch` folds 403 / 5xx / network into "no draft" and the editor shows the published body. Base did the same, so no regression; but the body's "only when no draft exists" is looser than the code ("when no draft body was read"), and an autosave from that state overwrites the pending draft — a pre-existing hazard, not this card's.

**Nine sites.** Base `63835d998f` and head read: every site is `served ?? baseline` (`baseline = effective ?? code ?? {}`; `effective ?? itemToSave` and `effective ?? draft` at the two refreshes); `config.toDraft` still runs at sites 1 and 2 and now at 3; no per-type exception. No draft-over-`effective` spread remains in the three files; `EmbeddedItemEditor.doSave` reads `layered.effective ?? layered.code` alone and saves publish mode; `doReset` / `doDiscardDraft` read the baseline alone. Remaining spreads in the two directories are patches on the draft (`{ ...draft, status }`), the create seed (`createBody.ts`) and `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s `full` over `draftBody ?? lay.effective` (draft wins wholesale) — none is the class; the runtime hosts' `handleResumeDraft` (Report / View config panels) replace wholesale. Two stale comments survive in touched files (nits): `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` Data pillar "`objDraft` below merges the draft on top", and `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` `OwdRow` docblock "(already merged over any pending draft)".

**PackageOwdOverviewPanel widening.** `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` rule 3 ("有界就地修豁免,四条全立"): ① same defect class, ② mechanical fix in the pinned shape, ③ no other claim on the file (10 open PRs' file lists read), ④ same gate family, no new verification surface — all hold; declared in the PR body and the report. What is SENT changes only when a draft exists: base sent `{ ...published, ...draft }` plus the two OWD edits (every key the draft deleted resurrected); head sends the draft plus the edits. Correct. Pre-existing and not this card's: the panel's `getDraft('object', name)` is package-unscoped while its save is package-scoped.

**Pins, re-run** in a detached worktree at head, `pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile`, every run under `os-verify-lock.sh`. Head: 3 files, 10 passed. Base leg (three source files `git restore --source=63835d998f`, blobs `08e198fe76` / `469bdf769c` / `72fa1eb906` confirmed, pin files at head): 3 files failed, 7 failed | 3 passed — "after the post-save refresh the editor draft has no dataset: expected { name: 'pipeline', …(8) } to not have property "dataset"", "expected { name: 'home', …(5) } to not have property "description"", "expected 'private' to be ''" twice, "expected { name: 'crm_contact', …(4) } to not have property "externalSharingModel"", "Unable to find an element with the text: acme_app · Navigation", "expected { name: 'notify_owner', …(4) } to not have property "description"". Restore proven: `git status --porcelain` empty, each blob equal to HEAD. The double stores draft rows raw, serves `effective` as the active row only, promotes and drains on publish — not tautological (its `getDraft` throws `NO_DRAFT` where the real client returns `null`; equivalent through the `.catch`). The triage pin is present as ruled: bound published matrix report, the REAL `ReportDefaultInspector` picker to `joined`, first PUT clean, post-save refresh without the six keys, second PUT without them, publish, published body and post-publish draft without them, `type` (with `name`, `label`) as the control. Ablations (anchor hit once, blob change proven, restored to a clean tree each): site 1 → 1 failed | 3 passed (GENERIC, `description`); site 2 → 2 failed | 2 passed (TRIAGE `dataset`, GENERIC); site 4 → 1 failed | 3 passed (`acme_app · Navigation`); site 8 → 2 failed (2) (LIST LOAD, SAVE) — all as reported, site 8's extra failure included.

**Siblings.** The 57 files the dev names (glob re-derived: `ResourceEditPage.*`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel*`, `ObjectSettingsPanel.owdAgreement`, `StudioDesignSurface.*`, `DataPillar.*`, `ObjectHooksPanel.*`, `ReportDefaultInspector.*`), three batches: 19 + 19 + 19 files passed, 109 + 62 + 100 = 271 tests passed. (A first attempt on borrowed symlinked `node_modules` crashed a vitest worker on `StudioDesignSurface.studioCanvasLeaf.test.tsx`; the fresh-install run above is the reading.)

### ② Semver level

`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`, Clause-② no: right. The diff is statement-level inside three components plus three new test files and one changeset; `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, `package.json`, props and registrations untouched; nothing exported, typed or prop-shaped moves.

Changeset, sentence by sentence: true against head and the server source; "stores a `?mode=draft` body raw and its `?state=draft` read returns that row raw" is a fair shorthand (the additive normalisations are spelled out in the PR body and none composes the body with another row); "`config.toDraft` still normalises whatever is taken, now on the post-publish refresh as well" true.

PR body: the H1 table verified symbol by symbol (loose only at `_draft` and "only ADDS", above); the 12-writer enumeration matches mine; the per-site table matches the diff; the ablation table matches my four re-runs; the edges hold; Acceptance notes true — `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s save re-bases on `fresh.effective ?? payload` and never reads the pending draft (draft mode only with `packageId`), `EmbeddedItemEditor` reads the baseline and saves publish mode, site 3 is inert because `promoteDraft` drains. Serial is stale by two merges: main is now `17b323e5ca` (+4 over base: #10754, #10766, #10763, #10774), none touching the three source files or either changeset; `git merge-tree --write-tree` clean, tree `d36314abd9`, exit 0.

Pending changesets naming the touched files: `check-changeset-claims` (report-only) and the PR's `changeset-claim-re-read` comment flag only `6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md` (a chunking claim, unaffected). NOT flagged, because it spells no file name in backticks: `.changeset/10746-joined-report-clears-binding.md` — pending, unreleased, publishing in the same release — ends "The metadata-admin editor rebuilds its draft as the served draft spread over `layered.effective` (on load, after each save and after publish), and `effective` is the published layer, so a report whose PUBLISHED version was bound gets those keys back in the draft after the first draft save until it is published, and a report already saved `joined` with stale keys is not repaired on load. Both are the host's draft-over-baseline merge, objectui#10765." At this head the first two claims are FALSE (the TRIAGE pin measures exactly that path) and the merge they describe no longer exists; only "not repaired on load" stays true. This is the WENT-FALSE class the gate's own header names ("If a claim did go false, CORRECT THE BODY … prose-only, with frontmatter untouched"). This is the FAIL below.
